title: Execute certified rational bounded-generator circuits
body:
I execute the retained bounded-generator program with exact rational coefficients and certified FFT, Toeplitz-shear and parity-triangular gates. PR4198 checked the generator macro through exact matrix callbacks. I replace those callbacks with the actual gate schedules and prove one coefficient, rounding and storage budget for arbitrary dirty source and target banks.

For a rational matrix `T` of dyadic size `m=2^d`, I generate its exact Stein decomposition and retain the source order `P; +G; inverse(P); -G`. I reuse the same stored triangular inverse. For compensation I negate the stored spectral multipliers while retaining the source's cyclic-then-negacyclic order. Each unrounded term therefore has endpoint `Ghat(Phat-I)`, and the errors from completed terms add.

I prove

`||rounded_output - S(T) input||₂ <= Delta*R + D*Kexec*m*2^-F < 2^-t`,

with `Delta <= r*(KG+1)*eta`, explicit polynomial `Kexec`, and depth `D=r*(8d²+32d+18)`. I give the four checkpoint prefix/suffix forms and bound their inverses. I use `Kexec²` for intermediate rounding accumulation, preserve incoming precision, and include scaled multipliers and reciprocal leaves in the word-width bound. The online records and gate temporaries use `O(F0+t+log m+log(1+BE)+log R)` bits, where `BE` bounds the Stein displacement norm. I leave complete coefficient setup and physical delivery costs open.

The full-program evidence covers 57 matrices, 71 generators, 5,614 gates and 172 rounded states. I collect all 50 predecessor shear matrices from the retained exact Schur walk, including its complex corner fixture, and add seven stress matrices. I check rank by separate elimination, both Stein identities, full matrix endpoints, exact unrounded source restoration and charged rounded restoration. Selected root-Schur, dense-complex and large-scale cases also receive exact checkpoint prefix/suffix and inverse checks.

Controls reject omitted restoration or compensation, extra coefficient-row conjugation, loss of tiny exact rank, discarded incoming precision and inadequate phase precision. A half-grid control demonstrates that independent nearest-up rounding of positive and negative coefficients need not cancel. I retain the original FFT and triangular proofs, controls and complete scientific receipts.

At head `fdcdc2690910392f7b42dbae4155b7d7b5790abd`, all six registered normal/optimized commands pass. The full generator receipt is `f74e0efc459e9c3d44d8ca8b3a33dc0fccc31731d0829419c3d515fe7f0f1e02`. I checked 28 committed files and both source-history pins, then passed official export integrity and all six Git-free commands. All 29 export files remained unchanged. The full generator commands took 4.368 and 4.371 seconds. Export SHA256: `6ed6556942e7defff248038867b6504424c964027895792692e83116f1f55cc1`; receipt SHA256: `70f6a5b0e1d70fe3945efa6e2cff4248a333c8d6e2a4885d636e02e45ab530d0`.

I matched all six successful [hosted records](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39454327335) to the export, including all three complete scientific digests and the unchanged-input step. I checked the exact test-merge parents and local archive ancestry. Test merge `532445e19d06be4de89cbf229c109ea53642be90` has publication tree `8f158e3df02dd92e7df63e191fe6951b43fab02c`.

Reproduce with CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rational-unitary-fft
```

I declare six normal/optimized commands, with a total timeout budget of 1,200 seconds. I authenticate the retained sources before execution and preserve their assertions under optimized Python. Exact dense matrices serve as checker oracles; their denominators do not represent the online data format. The finite Frobenius checks support consequences of the written operator proof; reviewers must assess the universal proof separately.

I preserve completed FFT revision `f02a4ab5ab70a8af80415ac35c5b48cd5a93a475` and recursive revision `203d04313c0cb2b4a4663a5a2d4d407e5a5b6d20`, with their [FFT](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39442494617) and [recursive](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39448550970) hosted evidence. Their scientific receipts remain `2e203e42d3d617e828e3341ffeb44254c931db2aebb8a040d04d67338b5b4016` and `d430fced712daa2e620b53a49dd09f0ba10ddddb4a4ff6b79d2abbbfd3afc1e6`.

I retain the exact PR4198 producer bytes from `e457d5e912a27307d725827aeca7198169320b84` and record their original blob/hash/path in `vendor/STEIN-PROVENANCE.json`. I pin the local copy through archive commit `0e181260108dd940a594fad6b912588bdee62522`; I do not claim that the sibling PR commit is an ancestor of this PR. The new proof rederives the generator identities and norm bounds it uses.

I start from unchanged canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7. I change only `research/rational-unitary-fft/` and leave the selected frontier unchanged. Before publication I refreshed main and checked 15 recent PR records, 6/726 hub comments and the PR's unchanged feedback state. [Discussion4202](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202) retains the source pins, expansion decision, live overlap coverage and previous results. The next obligation is the actual full Toeplitz recursion, followed by Gaussian/physical integration.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. I credit Vlado Vojdanovski/PR1673 for the generator/compiler identity, Schur producer, FFT/shear and parity schedules; Chafik Boukhalfa/PR628 for certified phases; Cinna Davis for the later caller; and the classical Fourier, structured-matrix and Gram-Schmidt lineage. Internal agents belong to the author process. Full caller acceptance, physical lowering and independent mathematical review remain open.
